svg.title: BLD_RUG_ARCADE_W proposed architectural sheet
svg.text: Three rug-display arches and one pier form a shared commercial frontage; three upper screens belong only to the three arches.
Source envelope dimensions are observed; bay counts and datums follow the proposed card. These
are visual-design elevations, not new floor plans or structural engineering. Existing skyline
fixtures, roof geometry and collision remain source-owned.
End views repeat once per wing; lengths above are the owning massing depth. Named attached
frontages take precedence over quiet faces. No automatic return windows, fake doors, balcony or
M02 / M05: inspect reveal and full body sweep before modeling.
METRES / a increases with source frontage axis / elevations are envelope studies
